descripcion: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the site administrator to have configured the Thickbox lightbox effect with the "Try to apply to all images" context (thumbEffectContext=all_images), and exploitation additionally depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment so that subsequent comments from that author are auto-approved. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The ShortPixel Image Optimizer – Optimize Images, Convert WebP & AVIF plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.6.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the administrator to have enabled the 'Deliver WebP/AVIF images using the ShortPixel CDN' (useCDN) option, after which any unauthenticated visitor can submit a comment containing a crafted url() payload inside an allowed HTML construct such as , which WordPress comment kses preserves on save; the dangerous attribute-boundary breakout occurs only at render time inside the ob_start output-buffer rewriter, where kses does not apply. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The kses sanitization pass in classes/Sanitize/Kses.php uses wp_kses_allowed_html('post') augmented with iframe[src] and the data: protocol; because wp_kses_attr_check accepts any data-* attribute on any allowed tag without inspecting its value, a payload embedded inside a data-ac-tip attribute survives intact and is subsequently assigned to innerHTML by assets/js/table.js, bypassing the apparent mitigation entirely. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-1 (the File Upload field's element_id)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-1794; exploitation requires that the Forminator form's File Upload field is left at plugin defaults (no 'custom-files' restriction configured) and that the server maps no Content-Type to the .rtx extension — the default behavior of the Debian/Ubuntu Apache package used by the official WordPress Docker image and many shared hosts. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '[]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_kses_post() sanitization applied via Redux_Helpers::sanitize_array() is bypassed — not broken — because an <a class="thickbox" title="&lt;img onerror=...&gt;"> payload uses only kses-allowed tags and attributes, with the entity-encoded onerror handler surviving storage as inert text that the browser decodes when WordPress core's thickbox.js reads the title attribute and writes it into the modal as HTML. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The Organize Media Folder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'EXIF.DateTimeOriginal' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.00 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This bypass of wp_filter_post_kses means the injected payload survives regardless of the uploader's unfiltered_html capability; Subscriber-level access becomes sufficient when a front-end attachment-upload integration such as bbPress with forumAttachments is active, and exploitation requires no special configuration because the %created_timestamp% placeholder is included in the caption template by default. Exploitation by attackers with subscriber-level access and above requires that bbPress and gd-bbpress-attachments (forumAttachments) are installed and configured so that Subscribers/Participants can post attachments through a frontend forum form. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'User-Agent header (stored to comment_agent)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.26.45 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that an administrator has saved a report whose SQL query selects attacker-controlled data such as comment_agent, and that the attacker can identify the saved report's slug — a condition trivially met when the administrator publishes the report on a public page via the [SQLREPORT] shortcode. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Shortcodes Ultimate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including, 7.9.1 This is due to su_get_current_url() interpolating the raw Host request header into the authority portion of a URL that is then passed to esc_url() — which by design preserves '[' and ']' inside the authority so IPv6 literal hosts remain valid — and the [su_qrcode] shortcode substituting that value into its data attribute (the documented %CURRENT_URL% token) before feeding it to do_shortcode(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include arbitrary PHP files that reside within the active theme's root directory (bounded because '/' inside an attribute value terminates parse_url()'s host and is then percent-encoded and stripped), and — when the shipped-default 'Unsafe features' option remains on — to read arbitrary post meta of any post, on any front-end page that renders [su_qrcode data="%CURRENT_URL%"]. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The Flutterwave Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The storing endpoint is accessible without authentication because the required nonce is publicly exposed on any front-end page rendering the plugin's [flw-pay-form], [flw-pay-button], or [flw-donation-form] shortcodes, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to scrape and reuse it. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH
